review_basis: Manual identity and scope review of all local source JSON records against current release project/site tables and linked evidence metadata. This is a local-record reconciliation, not a new live verification of every external source claim.

relationship_definitions.exact_project_match: The same named development and current project scope; enrich existing project but keep source-specific capacity and date scope.
relationship_definitions.same_site_distinct_scope: Known same campus/site, but source encompasses broader campus or additional phases; preserve a separate source-scope project at the existing site.
relationship_definitions.multi_site_program: A source record explicitly covers more than one physical site; attach context without creating or merging a counted physical site.
relationship_definitions.unique_source_record: No matching named development found in the current release. Independent source record, not a claim of surveyed physical uniqueness.
relationship_definitions.unresolved_identity: Potential source-internal duplicate or umbrella/tenant relationship lacks enough identity evidence; retain full record outside independent counts until resolved.

rules: Never match solely on coordinates, town/county names, generic operator names, or regional program announcements.
Preserve whole-campus versus building/phase scopes, and do not sum overlapping campus/phase capacity.
A partially operational campus can contain an under-construction phase; these statuses are not inherently contradictory.
A later source review date does not prove a later physical observation. Never overwrite selected physical status automatically.
Retain existing reviewed geometry and all uncertainty; source administrative centroids do not supersede it.
Local-record identity reconciliation does not revalidate external claims or convert estimated/projected metrics to observed facts.
